title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by the equation: $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. We need to determine if $$f(x)=|x|$$ can fit the data in the scatterplot.

title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot. Does the relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ appear linear, quadratic, or something else?

title: Considering Absolute Value
text: The function $$f(x)=|x|$$ transforms all $$x$$ values to their absolute values. Consider how this transformation affects the linearity of the data.

title: Checking Linearity
text: Does the scatterplot suggest a linear relationship that can be modeled by $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+|x_i| \beta_2$$?
